verses.original: וַיִּ֨מְלָךְ־ מֶ֔לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֖הוּ בֶּן־ יֹֽאשִׁיָּ֑הוּ תַּ֗חַת כָּנְיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָקִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר הִמְלִ֛יךְ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֥ר מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל בְּאֶ֥רֶץ יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yim·lāḵ- me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ben- yō·šî·yā·hū ta·ḥaṯ kā·nə·yā·hū ben- yə·hō·w·yā·qîm ’ă·šer him·lîḵ nə·ḇū·ḵaḏ·reṣ·ṣar me·leḵ- bā·ḇel bə·’e·reṣ yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made Zedekiah son of Josiah the king of Judah and he reigned . . . in place of Coniah son of Jehoiakim

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֛ע ה֥וּא וַעֲבָדָ֖יו וְעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ אֶל־ דִּבְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר דִּבֶּ֔ר בְּיַ֖ד יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִֽיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šā·ma‘ hū wa·‘ă·ḇā·ḏāw wə·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ’el- diḇ·rê Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber bə·yaḏ yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî
verses.literal: But he and his officers and the people of the land refused to obey the words that the LORD had spoken through Jeremiah the prophet

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ אֶת־ יְהוּכַ֣ל בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֗ה וְאֶת־ צְפַנְיָ֤הוּ בֶן־ מַֽעֲשֵׂיָה֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹ֑ר הִתְפַּלֶּל־ נָ֣א בַעֲדֵ֔נוּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū ’eṯ- yə·hū·ḵal ben- še·lem·yāh wə·’eṯ- ṣə·p̄an·yā·hū ḇen- ma·‘ă·śê·yāh hak·kō·hên ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr hiṯ·pal·lel- nā ḇa·‘ă·ḏê·nū ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: Yet King Zedekiah sent Jehucal son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the priest the son of Maaseiah to Jeremiah the prophet with the message Please pray to the LORD our God for us

verses.original: וְיִרְמְיָ֕הוּ בָּ֥א וְיֹצֵ֖א בְּת֣וֹךְ הָעָ֑ם וְלֹֽא־ נָתְנ֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בֵּ֥ית הַכְּלִיא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yir·mə·yā·hū bā wə·yō·ṣê bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ām wə·lō- nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·ṯōw bêṯ hak·kə·lī
verses.literal: Now Jeremiah was free to come and go among the people for they had not yet put him in prison . . .

verses.original: וְחֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹ֖ה יָצָ֣א מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַיִּשְׁמְע֨וּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֜ים הַצָּרִ֤ים עַל־ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ אֶת־ שִׁמְעָ֔ם וַיֵּ֣עָל֔וּ מֵעַ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥêl par·‘ōh yā·ṣā mim·miṣ·rā·yim way·yiš·mə·‘ū hak·kaś·dîm haṣ·ṣā·rîm ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim ’eṯ- šim·‘ām way·yê·‘ā·lū mê·‘al yə·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: Pharaoh’s army had left Egypt and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard the report they withdrew from . . . Jerusalem

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ דְּבַר־ יְהוָ֔ה אֶל־ יִרְמְיָ֥הוּ הַנָּבִ֖יא לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî də·ḇar- Yah·weh ’el- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the word of the LORD came to Jeremiah the prophet

verses.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֤ה תֹֽאמְרוּ֙ אֶל־ מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֔ה הַשֹּׁלֵ֧חַ אֶתְכֶ֛ם אֵלַ֖י לְדָרְשֵׁ֑נִי הִנֵּ֣ה׀ חֵ֣יל פַּרְעֹ֗ה הַיֹּצֵ֤א לָכֶם֙ לְעֶזְרָ֔ה שָׁ֥ב לְאַרְצ֖וֹ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl kōh ṯō·mə·rū ’el- me·leḵ yə·hū·ḏāh haš·šō·lê·aḥ ’eṯ·ḵem ’ê·lay lə·ḏā·rə·šê·nî hin·nêh ḥêl par·‘ōh hay·yō·ṣê lā·ḵem lə·‘ez·rāh šāḇ lə·’ar·ṣōw miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: This is what the LORD the God of Israel says that you are to tell . . . the king of Judah who sent you to Me Behold Pharaoh’s army which has marched out to help you will go back to its own land of Egypt

verses.original: וְשָׁ֙בוּ֙ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְנִלְחֲמ֖וּ עַל־ הָעִ֣יר הַזֹּ֑את וּלְכָדֻ֖הָ וּשְׂרָפֻ֥הָ בָאֵֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·ḇū hak·kaś·dîm wə·nil·ḥă·mū ‘al- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ ū·lə·ḵā·ḏu·hā ū·śə·rā·p̄u·hā ḇā·’êš
verses.literal: Then the Chaldeans will return and fight against this city They will capture it and burn it down . . .

verses.original: כֹּ֣ה׀ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אַל־ תַּשִּׁ֤אוּ נַפְשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָלֹ֛ךְ יֵלְכ֥וּ מֵעָלֵ֖ינוּ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כִּי־ לֹ֖א יֵלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’al- taš·ši·’ū nap̄·šō·ṯê·ḵem lê·mōr hā·lōḵ yê·lə·ḵū mê·‘ā·lê·nū hak·kaś·dîm kî- lō yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: This is what the LORD says Do not deceive yourselves by saying The Chaldeans will go away for good . . . . . . for they will not

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הִכִּיתֶ֞ם כָּל־ חֵ֤יל כַּשְׂדִּים֙ הַנִּלְחָמִ֣ים אִתְּכֶ֔ם וְנִ֨שְׁאֲרוּ בָ֔ם אֲנָשִׁ֖ים מְדֻקָּרִ֑ים אִ֤ישׁ בְּאָהֳלוֹ֙ יָק֔וּמוּ וְשָֽׂרְפ֛וּ אֶת־ הָעִ֥יר הַזֹּ֖את בָּאֵֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- hik·kî·ṯem kāl- ḥêl kaś·dîm han·nil·ḥā·mîm ’it·tə·ḵem wə·niš·’ă·rū ḇām ’ă·nā·šîm mə·ḏuq·qā·rîm ’îš bə·’ā·ho·lōw yā·qū·mū wə·śā·rə·p̄ū ’eṯ- hā·‘îr haz·zōṯ bā·’êš
verses.literal: Indeed if you were to strike down the entire army of the Chaldeans that is fighting against you and only wounded men remained . . . in their tents they would still get up and burn this city down

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּהֵֽעָלוֹת֙ חֵ֣יל הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים מֵעַ֖ל יְרֽוּשָׁלִָ֑ם מִפְּנֵ֖י חֵ֥יל פַּרְעֹֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·hê·‘ā·lō·wṯ ḥêl hak·kaś·dîm mê·‘al yə·rū·šā·lim mip·pə·nê ḥêl par·‘ōh
verses.literal: When the Chaldean army withdrew from Jerusalem for fear of Pharaoh’s army

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵ֤א יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָלֶ֖כֶת אֶ֣רֶץ בִּנְיָמִ֑ן לַחֲלִ֥ק מִשָּׁ֖ם בְּת֥וֹךְ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê yir·mə·yā·hū mî·rū·šā·lim lā·le·ḵeṯ ’e·reṣ bin·yā·min la·ḥă·liq miš·šām bə·ṯō·wḵ hā·‘ām
verses.literal: Jeremiah started to leave Jerusalem to go to the land of Benjamin to claim his portion there among the people

verses.original: וַיְהִי־ ה֞וּא בְּשַׁ֣עַר בִּנְיָמִ֗ן וְשָׁם֙ בַּ֣עַל פְּקִדֻ֔ת וּשְׁמוֹ֙ יִרְאִיָּ֔יה בֶּן־ שֶֽׁלֶמְיָ֖ה בֶּן־ חֲנַנְיָ֑ה וַיִּתְפֹּ֞שׂ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָ֤הוּ הַנָּבִיא֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אֶל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֖ים אַתָּ֥ה נֹפֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî- hū bə·ša·‘ar bin·yā·min wə·šām ba·‘al pə·qi·ḏuṯ ū·šə·mōw yir·’î·yāyh ben- še·lem·yāh ben- ḥă·nan·yāh way·yiṯ·pōś ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū han·nā·ḇî lê·mōr ’el- hak·kaś·dîm ’at·tāh nō·p̄êl
verses.literal: But when he reached the Gate of Benjamin the captain of the guard whose name was Irijah son of Shelemiah the son of Hananiah seized him . . . and said You are deserting to the Chaldeans

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֜הוּ שֶׁ֗קֶר אֵינֶ֤נִּי נֹפֵל֙ עַל־ הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְלֹ֥א שָׁמַ֖ע אֵלָ֑יו וַיִּתְפֹּ֤שׂ יִרְאִיָּיה֙ בְּיִרְמְיָ֔הוּ וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ אֶל־ הַשָּׂרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū še·qer ’ê·nen·nî nō·p̄êl ‘al- hak·kaś·dîm wə·lō šā·ma‘ ’ê·lāw way·yiṯ·pōś yir·’î·yāyh bə·yir·mə·yā·hū way·ḇi·’ê·hū ’el- haś·śā·rîm
verses.literal: That is a lie Jeremiah replied I am not deserting to the Chaldeans But Irijah would not listen to him instead, he arrested Jeremiah and took him to the officials

verses.original: וַיִּקְצְפ֧וּ הַשָּׂרִ֛ים עַֽל־ יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ וְהִכּ֣וּ אֹת֑וֹ וְנָתְנ֨וּ אוֹת֜וֹ בֵּ֣ית הָאֵס֗וּר בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר כִּֽי־ אֹת֥וֹ עָשׂ֖וּ לְבֵ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ṣə·p̄ū haś·śā·rîm ‘al- yir·mə·yā·hū wə·hik·kū ’ō·ṯōw wə·nā·ṯə·nū ’ō·w·ṯōw bêṯ hā·’ê·sūr bêṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān has·sō·p̄êr kî- ’ō·ṯōw ‘ā·śū lə·ḇêṯ hak·ke·le
verses.literal: The officials were angry with Jeremiah and they beat him and placed him in jail . . . in the house of Jonathan the scribe for it had been made into a prison . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י בָ֧א יִרְמְיָ֛הוּ אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַבּ֖וֹר וְאֶל־ הַֽחֲנֻ֑יוֹת וַיֵּֽשֶׁב־ שָׁ֥ם יִרְמְיָ֖הוּ יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî ḇā yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- bêṯ hab·bō·wr wə·’el- ha·ḥă·nu·yō·wṯ way·yê·šeḇ- šām yir·mə·yā·hū yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: So Jeremiah went into a cell . . . in the dungeon and remained there . . . a long time . . .

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁלַח֩ הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֜הוּ וַיִּקָּחֵ֗הוּ וַיִּשְׁאָלֵ֨הוּ הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ בְּבֵיתוֹ֙ בַּסֵּ֔תֶר וַיֹּ֕אמֶר הֲיֵ֥שׁ דָּבָ֖ר מֵאֵ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֙הוּ֙ יֵ֔שׁ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר בְּיַ֥ד מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל תִּנָּתֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·laḥ ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·yiq·qā·ḥê·hū way·yiš·’ā·lê·hū ham·me·leḵ bə·ḇê·ṯōw bas·sê·ṯer way·yō·mer hă·yêš dā·ḇār mê·’êṯ Yah·weh way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū yêš way·yō·mer bə·yaḏ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel tin·nā·ṯên
verses.literal: Later, King Zedekiah sent for Jeremiah and received him in his palace where he asked him privately Is there a word from the LORD There is . . . Jeremiah replied . . . You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֑הוּ מֶה֩ חָטָ֨אתִֽי לְךָ֤ וְלַעֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ וְלָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֔ה כִּֽי־ נְתַתֶּ֥ם אוֹתִ֖י אֶל־ בֵּ֥ית הַכֶּֽלֶא׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yir·mə·yā·hū ’el- ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū meh ḥā·ṭā·ṯî lə·ḵā wə·la·‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā wə·lā·‘ām haz·zeh kî- nə·ṯat·tem ’ō·w·ṯî ’el- bêṯ hak·ke·le
verses.literal: Then Jeremiah asked . . . King Zedekiah How have I sinned against you or your servants or these people that you have put me in prison . . .

verses.original: וְאַיּוֹ נְבִ֣יאֵיכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ נִבְּא֥וּ לָכֶ֖ם לֵאמֹ֑ר לֹֽא־ יָבֹ֤א מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶל֙ עֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל הָאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ʾay·yō nə·ḇî·’ê·ḵem ’ă·šer- nib·bə·’ū lā·ḵem lê·mōr lō- yā·ḇō me·leḵ- bā·ḇel ‘ă·lê·ḵem wə·‘al hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: Where are your prophets who prophesied to you claiming The king of Babylon will not come against you . . . or this land

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה שְֽׁמַֽע־ נָ֖א אֲדֹנִ֣י הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ תִּפָּל־ נָ֤א תְחִנָּתִי֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְאַל־ תְּשִׁבֵ֗נִי בֵּ֚ית יְהוֹנָתָ֣ן הַסֹּפֵ֔ר וְלֹ֥א אָמ֖וּת שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh šə·ma‘- nā ’ă·ḏō·nî ham·me·leḵ tip·pāl- nā ṯə·ḥin·nā·ṯî lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā wə·’al- tə·ši·ḇê·nî bêṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān has·sō·p̄êr wə·lō ’ā·mūṯ šām
verses.literal: But now please listen O my lord the king May my petition come . . . before you Do not send me back to the house of Jonathan the scribe or I will die there

verses.original: וַיְצַוֶּ֞ה הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּ֗הוּ וַיַּפְקִ֣דוּ אֶֽת־ יִרְמְיָהוּ֮ בַּחֲצַ֣ר הַמַּטָּרָה֒ וְנָתֹן֩ ל֨וֹ כִכַּר־ לֶ֤חֶם לַיּוֹם֙ מִח֣וּץ הָאֹפִ֔ים עַד־ תֹּ֥ם כָּל־ הַלֶּ֖חֶם מִן־ הָעִ֑יר וַיֵּ֣שֶׁב יִרְמְיָ֔הוּ בַּחֲצַ֖ר הַמַּטָּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ṣaw·weh ham·me·leḵ ṣiḏ·qî·yā·hū way·yap̄·qi·ḏū ’eṯ- yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh wə·nā·ṯōn lōw ḵik·kar- le·ḥem lay·yō·wm mi·ḥūṣ hā·’ō·p̄îm ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- hal·le·ḥem min- hā·‘îr way·yê·šeḇ yir·mə·yā·hū ba·ḥă·ṣar ham·maṭ·ṭā·rāh
verses.literal: So King Zedekiah gave orders for Jeremiah to be placed in the courtyard of the guard and given a loaf of bread daily from the street of the bakers until all the bread in the city was gone So Jeremiah remained in the courtyard of the guard
